name: Liquid organic hydrogen carriers (MCH, DBT)
applications: storage in existing oil tanks and tankers
principle: Hydrogen is chemically bound to a liquid carrier, such as toluene to make methylcyclohexane (MCH), by catalytic hydrogenation. The MCH is a stable liquid at ambient conditions and moves in ordinary chemical tankers and tanks. At the destination, catalytic dehydrogenation releases the hydrogen and the toluene returns for reuse.
key_equipment: dehydrogenation reactor and fired or electric heater

performance.basis: Brunei to Kawasaki AHEAD demonstration (NEDO), maximum capacity

source.note: Chiyoda presentation at IEEJ/APERC symposium, 11 October 2023

reference_plants.name: AHEAD Brunei to Kawasaki hydrogen supply chain
reference_plants.capacity: up to 210 t/yr hydrogen as MCH

source.note: Chiyoda presentation at IEEJ/APERC symposium, 11 October 2023

advantages: Ambient-temperature liquid uses existing oil logistics
limitations: Dehydrogenation needs substantial heat at the import site
